citations.assessment: Ulla is explicitly at Rav Menashe’s house. Rabbah speaks in response to Ulla’s concern about knocking on a door on Shabbat.
The checked Yerushalmi has bare Menashe sit before R. Zeora in the reading incident. The Rav title is Heilprin’s characterization of the name in that witness.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

holds.raw: לא ידעתי למה עשה לו מדור בפני עצמו כי עולא ורב יהודה בדור א' א"כ א' הוא הנ"ל שהיה תלמיד רב יהודה
holds.reason: The texts establish the separate Menashe notices. The claimed contemporaneity and identification are part of Heilprin’s objection to dividing them and are preserved as such.

holds.raw: ונראה כי הוא תלמיד רב יהודה הנ"ל
holds.reason: The meeting with Zeora does not by itself establish the proposed joining to the Yehudah disciple. Preserve the expressed degree of confidence.
